procedural_matters: GER 696 was represented by Katharina SCHWACHHOFER.
USA 49 was represented by Paris HENKEN.
Tim WADLOW (coach of USA 49) attended the hearing as an observer.
The International Jury and USA 49 presented tracking evidence.
Anouk GEURTS (BEL 18) gave evidence as a witness for USA 49.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 6 - 7 knots of wind and flat water.
During the second upwind leg, GER 696 was sailing close-hauled on starboard tack and USA 49 was sailing close-hauled on port tack, on a converging course with GER 696.
When the boats were less than one boat length apart, GER 696 bore away by less than 10º and passed half a boat length astern of USA 49.
conclusions: If GER 696 had not borne away, USA 49 would have crossed ahead of GER 696, so GER 696 had no need to take avoiding action.
Therefore, USA 49 did not break RRS 10.
